  • Hezbollah firing/harassing Israel daily. Front remains active.

  • US reportedly struck Iranian targets after an attack on a cargo ship. Retaliatory claims followed.

  • Pakistan mediating between parties.

Aviation / Mobility

  • OSINT flight scan: major regional airport closures reported (03:00): Iran, Israel, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon, Jordan. Airspace disruption persists.

Domestic / Public Mood

  • Polls show majority of Israelis favor hardline security measures on Lebanon, Iran, Palestinians.
  • 🟢 Good News: Israel agreed to limited withdrawals in Lebanon. A US‑backed Israel‑Lebanon framework was announced. Both could lower local tensions if implemented.
Bottom line: Escalating.

Situation Report — Day 27

  • Active: US/Israeli strikes on Iran; explosions near the Strait of Hormuz; sirens in Beit Aryeh.
  • US carried out strikes inside Iran after a cargo ship was attacked in the Strait of Hormuz. Multiple US and media confirmations.
  • Iran/IRGC say they struck US positions in the region and threaten further response.
  • Trump announced a SECOND 10-day pause on strikes targeting Iranian energy (deadline Apr 6, 2026, 8 PM ET), claiming an Iranian request; Iran denies direct talks. First 5-day pause (Mar 23) was violated by subsequent US/Israeli strikes on Isfahan and Khorramshahr.
  • Pakistan is mediating between the parties.
  • Northern Border / Lebanon: Israel and Lebanon signed a US-brokered framework in DC. The deal includes a slight IDF pullback and a process aimed at disarming Hezbollah. Israel reportedly agreed to withdraw from two areas in Lebanon. Hezbollah attacks continue daily.
  • IDF conducting searches in Beit Aryeh after infiltration sirens sounded.
  • Strait of Hormuz / Shipping: Attacked cargo ship prompted US retaliation. Explosions reported along Iran’s southern coast. Iran grants Hormuz passage to friendly states (Russia, India, China) while restricting others. UAE made a rare security call with Iran.
  • Airspace / Flights: Regional airspace disruption. Scans show major airports in Iran, Israel, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon and Jordan closed at times. Commercial traffic sharply reduced; occasional military flights detected.
  • Politics / Military: US says ready to discuss but will respond to violence. US Senate Republicans rejected a war-powers resolution. Reuters/TASS/AP provide cross-confirmation of strikes and IRGC claims.
  • 🟢 Good News: Framework deal with Lebanon signed; limited IDF withdrawals agreed (first concrete de-escalation step on northern front).
  • Threat assessment: Escalating.
